description: CAMB scoping test for future TEP high-ℓ production run

tep_in_camb.note: CAMB can vary w but cannot exactly reproduce the TEP conformal factor M(z). A source-code modification is required for an exact TEP implementation.

path_forward.option_a: Patch hi_class clipy interface to handle tep_mode Cls. Requires C/Python debugging of the binning matrices.
path_forward.option_b: Implement tep_mode in CAMB Fortran source. Requires modifying the Friedmann equation and perturbation equations to include the conformal factor M(z). Estimated 1-2 weeks.
path_forward.option_c: Use alternate high-ℓ likelihood (ACT DR6, SPT) with different interface layer that may not have the same NaN issue.
path_forward.recommended: Option (b) — CAMB re-implementation — is the most robust long-term path. CAMB is actively maintained, widely used, and its Python interface is cleaner than CLASS for custom modifications. The present low-ℓ result remains the primary constraint until high-ℓ is ready.
